text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, when I came to check on the gym――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
choice_data_list: (……Is that a crowd getting hyped up?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Drawing the gazes of both Umamusume and 
Trainers was Gentildonna. She appeared to 
be merely carrying luggage, but...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: This one will do nicely, won't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
choice_data_list: !? What was that sound just now……!

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
An iron ball, I tell you! An iron ball! An 
iron ball as heavy as a baby elephant...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
We imported it from America on a trial 
basis, and while we were discussing how to 
move it to the gym, sheââ

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, after making such a fuss about 
needing extra hands, this is all it is...?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If you cannot even lift this much, it is 
not merely a matter of insufficient 
training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even for an Umamusume, lifting an iron 
ball the weight of a small elephant would 
be no easy feat. To think she carried it 
purely through arm strength...
choice_data_list: I wonder if there's a trick to it...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: The peanut gallery is so noisy...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It shouldn't be that heavy. It's 
practically like lifting a barbell with 
one hand.
choice_data_list:
(You're not supposed to lift a barbell 
with one hand, right...!?)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to let the Chairwoman know. If 
we don't have at least fifty more 
kilograms, we can't even begin to talk.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Are you suggesting that someone like me 
resorted to cheap, superficial tricks...?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
There is no trick to speak of. Everything 
is――

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: A pure, and noble…… "strength," that is.
